purpose: Intended NewYou bilingual contact-support entry and form wording, conditional submission outcomes and safe handling of private information.
content_owner: Content & Media owns exact words/version; any future support-request record needs an approved authoritative owner
risk: Class A + B; sensitive privacy/security wording requires relevant review

includes: form introduction, topic/subject/details and reply-email labels
optional attachment text (only if upload is actually supported)
conditional submission-confirmed, failed, uncertain, duplicate, stale and unavailable states
excludes: selecting a SupportCase Domain owner or creating a ticket/case system
defining categorical taxonomy, SLAs, response times or business case-state transitions
automatic account recovery, authentication or support authority through contact
guaranteeing that email delivery or a help message was received
requiring an attachment, identity document, health record or private account data
production, public contact-channel launch, implementation or provider permission

transitions: editing -> submitting on one authorised, valid submit intent
submitting -> received_confirmed only on current authoritative receipt confirmation
submitting -> not_sent only on a known no-effect or rejected outcome
submitting -> outcome_uncertain when receipt cannot be confirmed
editing/submitting -> stale if selected options or permissions are no longer current
editing/submitting -> unavailable when submission capability cannot be used
editing -> discarded after explicit unsent confirmation
not_sent/stale/unavailable -> editing only after safe correction and reread
outcome_uncertain -> received_confirmed/not_sent only through authoritative reconciliation
guards: No unconfirmed success claim or fabricated reference; {{reference}} renders only if issued by an authoritative source
No automatic resubmission after uncertain receipt; use idempotent operation identity or source reconciliation where supported
Do not permit duplicate click or conflicting request to create more than one confirmed source outcome
Public versus authenticated contact eligibility is determined by applicable governance and implemented route policy, not this copy
Optional attachment UI is hidden until secure media processing and privacy review support it
Account change, step-up, recovery, consent and privacy decisions stay with the relevant owners
No auto-fallback to another locale for required EN/AF content
submission_presentation_lifecycle.side_effects: Form display/edit/discard is UI-only. Submission may request an owned support communication outcome once a separate authoritative contract exists. This copy packet creates no such source action.
terminal: received_confirmed terminates the current submission attempt, not a support case
discarded terminates the current unsent edit
outcome_uncertain is nonterminal and requires reconciliation
submission_presentation_lifecycle.idempotency_recovery: An identical confirmed operation returns the same receipt; uncertain attempts cannot be marked as failed or retried blindly.

en.text: Tell us what you need help with so we can understand your question.

af.text: Vertel ons waarmee jy hulp nodig het sodat ons jou vraag kan verstaan.

en.text: Choose a topic

af.text: Kies ’n onderwerp

en.text: Choose the option that best describes what you need help with.

af.text: Kies die opsie wat die beste beskryf waarmee jy hulp nodig het.

en.text: That topic is no longer available. Choose another available option.

af.text: Daardie onderwerp is nie meer beskikbaar nie. Kies ’n ander beskikbare opsie.

en.text: Subject (optional)

af.text: Onderwerp (opsioneel)

en.text: Tell us what happened

af.text: Vertel ons wat gebeur het

en.text: Explain what you were trying to do and what happened. Please leave out passwords and verification codes.

af.text: Verduidelik wat jy probeer doen het en wat gebeur het. Moenie wagwoorde of verifikasiekodes insluit nie.

en.text: Email address for a reply

af.text: E-posadres vir terugvoer

en.text: Use an email address you can access.

af.text: Gebruik ’n e-posadres waartoe jy toegang het.

en.text: Attachments (optional)

af.text: Aanhangsels (opsioneel)

en.text: Add a file only if this option is available and it helps explain the problem.

af.text: Voeg slegs ’n lêer by as dié opsie beskikbaar is en dit help om die probleem te verduidelik.

en.text: Do not attach identity documents, medical records or other sensitive information unless a separately approved secure process specifically asks for them.

af.text: Moenie identiteitsdokumente, mediese rekords of ander sensitiewe inligting aanheg tensy ’n afsonderlik goedgekeurde, veilige proses dit uitdruklik vereis nie.

en.text: The file couldn't be added. Try another file or send your message without it.

af.text: Die lêer kon nie bygevoeg word nie. Probeer ’n ander lêer of stuur jou boodskap daarsonder.

en.text: Attachments aren't available right now. You can continue without one.

af.text: Aanhangsels is tans nie beskikbaar nie. Jy kan sonder ’n aanhangsel voortgaan.

en.text: We may need to verify your identity before discussing private account details or making account changes.

af.text: Ons sal dalk eers jou identiteit moet bevestig voordat ons privaat rekeningbesonderhede bespreek of rekeningveranderinge aanbring.

en.text: Send message

af.text: Stuur boodskap

en.text: Sending your message…

af.text: Besig om jou boodskap te stuur…

en.text: We've received your message.

af.text: Ons het jou boodskap ontvang.

en.text: Reference: {{reference}}

af.text: Verwysing: {{reference}}

en.text: Keep this reference if you need to follow up.

af.text: Hou hierdie verwysing byderhand as jy moet opvolg.

en.text: We couldn't send your message. Check the information and try again.

af.text: Ons kon nie jou boodskap stuur nie. Gaan die inligting na en probeer weer.

en.text: We couldn't confirm whether your message was received. Avoid sending it again immediately; use an available status or support option to check first.

af.text: Ons kon nie bevestig of jou boodskap ontvang is nie. Moenie dit dadelik weer stuur nie; gebruik eers ’n beskikbare status- of ondersteuningsopsie om na te gaan.

en.text: We've already received this message.

af.text: Ons het reeds hierdie boodskap ontvang.

en.text: Check the highlighted information before sending your message.

af.text: Gaan die aangeduide inligting na voordat jy jou boodskap stuur.

en.text: The available contact options have changed. Reload them before sending your message.

af.text: Die beskikbare kontakopsies het verander. Laai dit weer voordat jy jou boodskap stuur.

en.text: Messages can't be sent this way right now. Try another available support option.

af.text: Boodskappe kan tans nie op hierdie manier gestuur word nie. Probeer ’n ander beskikbare ondersteuningsopsie.

en.text: Leave without sending?

af.text: Gaan weg sonder om te stuur?

en.text: Your message hasn't been sent.

af.text: Jou boodskap is nog nie gestuur nie.

en.text: Discard message

af.text: Gooi boodskap weg

reuse_existing_keys.en: Never share your password, verification codes, sign-in or recovery links, or your verification app's secret key with support.
reuse_existing_keys.af: Moet nooit jou wagwoord, verifikasiekodes, aanmeld- of herstelskakels of die geheime sleutel van jou verifikasie-app met ondersteuning deel nie.

reuse_existing_keys.en: Contacting support does not verify your identity or authorise account changes.
reuse_existing_keys.af: Kontak met ondersteuning bevestig nie jou identiteit nie en magtig nie rekeningveranderinge nie.
